_note: Overlaid onto vendor/crDroidOTA/<device>.json by apply.sh -- NOT a patch. Upstream rewrites that file on every weekly release (filename, timestamp, md5, sha256, size), so a context patch against it breaks about once a week; a whole-file copy cannot. Only the fields listed here are read by vendor/lineage/build/tools/createjson.sh; everything else in the generated json (filename, download, timestamp, md5, sha256, size, version, os_patch_level, os_sdk_level) is computed from the zip that was just built.
